moa.t: Inhibits Na/K-ATPase: raises intracellular calcium (positive inotrope) and increases vagal tone (slows AV conduction)

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

cautions.t: Toxicity increased by hypokalaemia, hypomagnesaemia, hypercalcaemia and renal impairment

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, vomiting, anorexia, visual disturbance (yellow vision), bradycardia, almost any arrhythmia

monitoring.t: Potassium, renal function, heart rate, digoxin level if toxicity suspected
